name: tamil-voice-tts-android
description: Tamil Text to Speech Android App using Edge TTS (Pallavi, Saranya, Kani, Venba)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js','manifest.json','icon.svg','sw.js'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)); console.log('Assets prepared in www/');"
